item.title: Inside Texas A&M’s Scramble to Censor Its Curriculum
item.description: Documents reveal widespread uncertainty, even among administrators, over what professors could teach.By Jasper Smith and Megan Zahneis Documents reveal widespread uncertainty, even among administrators, over what professors could teach.

item.title: Ohio Proposes Bill to Ban 'Rebranding' of DEI Offices
item.description: Explore where college diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts are under attack.By Chronicle StaffLegislators want to get rid of DEI offices, end diversity trainings, banish diversity statements, and censor how professors talk about race, gender, and sexuality in mandatory courses.

item.title: Higher Ed ‘Has Lost Its North Star,’ Trump Official Tells Campus Leaders
item.description: By Rick Seltzer "I hope that you all ... have made it through the five stages of grief," Nicholas Kent, the under secretary of education, said of the administration’s aggressive push for change.

item.title: Illinois Wants to Spread More State Money Around. Not So Fast, Says Its Flagship.
item.description: By Lee Gardner A plan to award new funding to public colleges based on their financial need would "siphon resources" from the U. of Illinois, its president argues.

item.title: Michigan State Senior Who Explored Academe's Quirkier Side Wins David W. Miller Award for Young Journalists
item.description: By Chronicle Staff The prize, which recognizes the newsroom's top intern from the previous year, honors a former Chronicle reporter who was killed by a drunk driver while on assignment.

item.title: Citing ‘Wicked Ideologies,’ Pentagon Says It'll End Graduate Fellowships at 13 Universities
item.description: The federal government is reshaping its relationship with the nation's colleges. Here's the latest.By Chronicle Staff The Chronicle is tracking executive orders, statements from Trump, and agency actions that affect higher education, plus legal challenges directed at those measures. Here’s the latest.

item.title: To Fight AI, We Must Know Our Enemy
item.description: Teaching students to recognize the "tells" of LLM-generated prose.By Ellen O'Connell Whittet Teaching students to recognize the "tells" of LLM-generated prose.

item.title: Will Agentic AI Break Higher Education?
item.description: A new app offers to do students' work for them. Professors aren't ready.By Jason Gulya A new app offers to do students' work for them. Professors aren't ready.

item.title: The Right's Academic Civil War
item.description: Conservative scholars built a reform movement. Will conservative politicians destroy it? By Len Gutkin Conservative scholars built a reform movement. Will conservative politicians destroy it?

item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Scattered Student Protests in U.S. as Satellite Campuses Remain Remote
item.description: By Chronicle Staff Military strikes by the United States and Israel against Iran have upended the daily operations of American universities with campuses, programs, and students in the region.
